name: feega
description: Operate feega (infinite canvas for motion video and images) via MCP or CLI: canvases, nodes, generations, motion, gallery.

interface.longDescription: Drive feega from Codex or ChatGPT: edit canvases and nodes, run generations, and work with motion videos and the gallery. Prefer the bundled MCP tools when connected; otherwise use the feega CLI after OAuth login.
defaultPrompt: List my feega canvases and describe what is on the first one.
Add an image node with a minimal hero shot and run its generation.
